mathematics.assertion_tested: Finite exact audit that evaluated polyphase route queries have Hankel rank bounded by phase dimension; the two-tap family has full sampled Hankel rank equal to the phase dimension while sampled discrete residual signatures can be much larger; the order-2 route series matches the existing recurrence subsystem.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers and fractions for route evaluation and Hankel elimination.
mathematics.conventions: Polyphase route kernels E[r,s][q] are evaluated at integer coarse-lag variable z; scalar query is source phase 0 to target phase 0; chronological route words are represented by transposed evaluated route matrices in standard weighted-series order.
non_claims: Finite trials do not prove generic full Hankel rank.
Finite suffix signatures give lower bounds on discrete future-equivalence classes only.
The minimal-WFA/Hankel-rank theorem is an external classical theorem, not established by this computation.
The audit does not establish novelty.

residual_risks: The modern literature source was checked, but original Carlyle-Paz/Fliess papers were not independently authenticated in this episode.
No claim is made that every polyphase route packet is Hankel-minimal for every query.
result: Implementation and finite assertions verified in the stated exact range.
